target.existingRawSeedDisposition: observational-only; missing macOrigin cannot be retro-qualified

currentGap.captureProducer: factory/native/macos/capture.py currently invokes xcrun swiftc via logged() without receipt-backed resolver/compiler/tool/source/stream/output records
currentGap.normalizer: factory/native/macos/normalize.py currently emits conditions without macOrigin
currentGap.evidenceChecker: factory/native/macos/check_evidence.py currently validates capture/raw/image/PID joins without origin admission
currentGap.schemaDisposition: existing meta.conditions additionalProperties canonicalValue accepts macOrigin; no schema edit

requiredOriginBindings.case: canonical case JSON bytes + sha256 + byte count
requiredOriginBindings.source: actual Witness.swift bytes used by build
requiredOriginBindings.adapter: generated CaptureHost.swift bytes used by build
requiredOriginBindings.binary: fresh capture-host bytes used by all run channels
requiredOriginBindings.optionalAuxiliaryAX: required exactly when summary.freshAXClient.externalAX == AVAILABLE; absent when HELD

archivePolicy.reader: ArchiveByteReader with explicit macPathMap for absolute receipt paths
archivePolicy.historicalToolArchive: reusable only for exact matching tool hashes; otherwise successor archive required
archivePolicy.sourcePolicy: archive exact actual source bytes & generated SDK adapter bytes; do not infer from sourceHash labels

controls: tool before/after drift or wrong archived tool bytes
extra compiler argv source/flag or wrong cwd
nonzero exit, timeout, unowned PGID, or cleanup flag
freshAXClient AVAILABLE without exact auxiliaryAX receipt/source/binary

handoff.paddingCoordinator: Use fresh candidate IDs, exact origin PASS/issue codes, channel holds & 20-row count as separate dimensions. Do not transform old seed rows or infer parity.
handoff.rootIntegration: After producer output exists, call existing mac_origin_admission_issues with byte reader; preserve rejected evidence & reasons.
